review_notes: Principal family decision: Table 4 Panel B column 1 is the source-labeled baseline test of IFRS adoption on Synchronicity with full firm- and country-level controls. Columns 2–3 add the analyst-following moderator in a later conditioning analysis; columns 4–5 are country-median-adjusted sensitivity specifications, so they are not selected as the principal family.

Supporting fits retained recursively: the Eq. (1) firm-year market-model regressions generate R-squared used to construct Synchronicity, and the Eq. (3) probit generates Lambda used in the Table 4 column 1 second stage.

Needs review because the estimator for the Eq. (1) market-model fit is not reported. The paper also gives incompatible descriptions of DIFRS*: Eq. (3) defines the observed 0/1 adopter outcome, while Appendix 2 calls it the ex ante probability of adoption.
results_review_notes: Only the frozen baseline family, Table 4 Panel B column 1, was extracted. Foll and DIFRS×Foll in columns 2–3, other columns, and first-stage probit estimates were not included.
The paper reports table stars and clustered t values but no exact p-values or degrees of freedom; those remain unavailable.

calculation_provenance.policy: strict; no guessed degrees of freedom or normal approximations
